title: Summer-to-Move-In Countdown
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Organize every task between committing to a college and move-in day on a timeline, check them off, and watch for the summer-melt risks that keep admitted students from arriving.

learningObjectives: Students will organize their post-commitment tasks on a timeline from May to move-in day and carry them out before their deadlines, recognizing which missed steps put enrollment at risk.
educational.duration: 10 minutes now, then weekly through the summer

controls: My college, move-in date, and today date inputs
New task name and lane, Add task, Load Iowa example, and Reset buttons

keyQuestions: What is summer melt, and which tasks most often cause it?
Why do housing and orientation dates matter so much in May?
Who would you call first if a bill or form stopped you?
commonMisconceptions: Once you've deposited, nothing else is required until move-in.
Missing a summer deadline has no consequences.
assessmentOpportunities: Students enter every task for their college with real dates and identify the three tasks that most threaten enrollment if missed.
